newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SELLING PRESSURE DEPRESSES ROMANIA OTC MARKET.
newsitem.headline: SELLING PRESSURE DEPRESSES ROMANIA OTC MARKET.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed weaker on Thursday, mainly due to heavy supply of blue chips, traders said.

"Heavyweights were sold heavily today, and some investors made nice profits," one trader said. He said the market correction had been expected due to high price levels some of the listings had reached.
Operators forecast fresh lows on Friday, but expected a return of the bullish mood by the middle of the next week.
Three independent indices computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation went down from Wednesday's levels.
The VAB-RA all-share index dropped 1.8 percent to 6,461.3 points, BIG-OTC slipped by 3.23 percent to 4,946.47 and CAS-RQ fell 3.62 percent to 1,106 points.
Oil refineries were most hit by profit takers on Thursday, but traders said a rally would soon start thanks to their liquidity.

Petrobrazi oil refinery closed 4,500 lei down at 42,500, while Arpechim refinery went down 5,000 lei to close at 41,500. Petromidia, also a refinery in high demand over the past weeks, closed 2,000 lei weaker at 46,000.
Steel mill Sidex inched down 500 lei to 24,000, with traders they expected it to remain relatively stable on Friday.
Cement makers also lost steam, with Romcim shedding 500 lei to 129,000 and Romcim moving 1,000 lei down to 53,000.
Turnover fell to 30.8 billion lei on Thursady from 32.6 billion previous session.
